import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static long M = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int P = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();

        if (K == 0) {
            System.out.println(power(P, P - 1, M));
            return;
        }
        if (K == 1) {
            System.out.println(power(P, P, M));
            return;
        }

        int[] k_arr = new int[P];
        for (int x = 0; x < P; x++) {
            k_arr[x] = (int) (((long) K * x) % P);
        }

        boolean[] f = new boolean[P];
        int[] c = new int[P + 1];
        long ans = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) {
            if (f[i]) continue;

            int cnt = 1;
            int u = i;
            f[u] = true;
            while (!f[k_arr[u]]) {
                u = k_arr[u];
                f[u] = true;
                cnt++;
            }
            if (cnt < c.length) {
                c[cnt]++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 2; i < P; i++) {
            if (c[i] != 0) {
                long base = ((long) i * c[i]) + 1;
                ans = (ans * power(base % M, c[i], M)) % M;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static long power(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp % 2 == 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp /= 2;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
